source_caption_text:
#ABoogieWitDaHoodie is celebrating a decade of his debut studio album Artist with a special run of shows, bringing fans back to where it all started while honoring the project that helped shape his career.

Kicking off night one of his two sold-out hometown shows in Philadelphia, A Boogie made sure the night was about more than just celebrating his own legacy. 

He took a moment to pay tribute to fellow Philadelphia native and late rapper PnB Rock 🕊️ honoring his life, legacy, and lasting impact on the city and its music scene.

With a decade of music, memories, and milestones behind him, A Boogie’s anniversary run is proving to be a celebration of the journey, the city that raised him, and the people who helped make the Philadelphia music scene what it is today.
